## `Core/Graphics/Post/PostSettings.h`

- `struct BloomSettings` — Bloom: emissive drawing (style emission > 0) glows past its edges.
- `BloomSettings`: `float intensity = 0.0f` — Light added on top, 1: as bright as the source
- `BloomSettings`: `float radius = 1.0f` — Spread multiplier, 0.25 ..
- `struct GrainSettings` — Film grain that never repeats, stronger in the dark than on bright things such as text.
- `GrainSettings`: `float amount = 0.0f` — 0..1; subtle up to 0.15, heavy at 0.4
- `GrainSettings`: `float size = 1.0f` — One grain, in canvas units
- `struct TintSettings` — Colour multiplied over the image: a dark, cold colour gives a dark, cold look.
- `TintSettings`: `Color4 color { 255, 255, 255, 255 }` — Alpha is ignored
- `TintSettings`: `float amount = 0.0f` — 0: no tint, 1: the whole colour
- `struct WobbleSettings` — The image slowly bends and tilts.
- `WobbleSettings`: `float amount = 0.0f` — Largest move, in canvas units; uneasy at 3, hard to read at 12
- `WobbleSettings`: `float speed = 1.0f` — Rhythm multiplier; it can change while the effect runs
- `struct TapeSettings` — Worn video tape: a tracking band that rolls down the image, and lines that jump sideways.
- `TapeSettings`: `float band = 0.0f` — Tracking band 0..1
- `TapeSettings`: `float shift = 0.0f` — Largest sideways jump of a line, in canvas units; text stays readable up to about 2
- `TapeSettings`: `float speed = 1.0f` — How fast the band rolls; it can change while the effect runs
- `struct PostSettings` — Full-screen finish applied to the canvas when the frame is presented.
- `PostSettings`: `BloomSettings bloom`
- `PostSettings`: `float vignette = 0.0f` — Corner darkening 0..1
- `PostSettings`: `float scanlines = 0.0f` — Horizontal line darkening 0..1
- `PostSettings`: `float scanlineCount = 0.0f` — Lines over the canvas height (0: one per two canvas units)
- `PostSettings`: `float aberration = 0.0f` — Chromatic split at the edges, in canvas units
- `PostSettings`: `float fade = 0.0f` — Colour drained toward grey 0..1
- `PostSettings`: `TintSettings tint`
- `PostSettings`: `GrainSettings grain`
- `PostSettings`: `WobbleSettings wobble`
- `PostSettings`: `TapeSettings tape`
- `[[nodiscard]] PostSettings Mix(const PostSettings& from, const PostSettings& to, float t)` — Between two finishes, 't' clamped to 0..1: paint.Post() = Mix(calm, disturbed, danger).

## `Core/Graphics/Post/RenderQuality.h`

- `enum class GlowQuality { Full, Reduced, Off }` — Glow strength: Full; Reduced (weaker, smaller); Off (glows are not drawn).
- `enum class BloomQuality { Off, Half, Full }` — Bloom resolution: Off; Half (half-resolution source, the default); Full.
- `struct RenderQuality` — Player-selectable rendering cost and comfort.
- `RenderQuality`: `GlowQuality glow = GlowQuality::Full`
- `RenderQuality`: `BloomQuality bloom = BloomQuality::Half`
- `RenderQuality`: `bool backgroundEffects = true` — Decorative background animation (scanlines, drifting grids)
- `RenderQuality`: `bool screenMotion = true` — Off: no grain, wobble or tape in PostSettings, for players they trouble
